text: The town gathers
Six players take their seats: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra. Nobody at the table knows who the killer is.

name: Luna
text: I don’t trust anyone yet, but there’s nothing to go on.

name: Terra
text: I will listen before I decide who needs protecting.

name: Gemma
text: I need to see who acts weird first.

name: Sonnet
text: Just blend in, stay calm, watch who talks too much later.

name: Sol
text: I have nothing to go on yet, so I’ll listen.

name: Haiku
text: Nobody has facts yet, so I'll just watch who goes quiet and who jumps in too fast.

name: Sonnet
text: Hey everyone, good luck tonight, let's see who slips up first.

name: Haiku
text: Hey all. Who's gonna talk first, or do we just sit here?

name: Gemma
text: hey everyone, i'm just here for the snacks and to watch you guys panic.

name: Sol
text: Hey everyone, let’s see what people say before we settle on anyone.

name: Luna
text: Hi, everyone. Let’s see who talks first.

name: Terra
text: Hi everyone. I’m listening.
Night 1

name: Terra
text: No one stands out yet, so I should protect myself.

name: Sol
text: I have no real leads yet, so I’ll check someone quiet.

name: Sonnet
text: Nobody's shown anything yet, so I'll cut someone who sounds like they'd be sharp at tracking contradictions later.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra stayed quiet, just said "I'm listening" - watch for officer-type behavior from others too.
Night 1 passes with an attack, but the doctor got there first, so nobody is out. Everyone gets to keep their seat and their suspicions.
Day 1

name: Gemma
text: Everyone is being way too polite for a game with killers.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is acting very calm.

name: Gemma
text: why is everyone so chill? sol, you're being suspiciously relaxed for day one.

name: Sonnet
text: Nobody knows who I targeted, good — I can steer suspicion onto someone else now.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna and Terra both opened with near-identical "let's see who talks" lines.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's right that Sol seems calm, but Luna and Terra basically said the same thing twice — "let's see who talks." Feels like stalling.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is way too composed for a first day.

name: Gemma
text: Sonnet and Gemma both suspect Sol.

name: Sol
text: Gemma’s push on me is thin, and I want to see whether she has more.

name: Sol
text: Gemma called me suspicious for seeming relaxed on day one.

name: Gemma
text: if they're stalling, it's because they're waiting for us to do the work. terra, you've been quiet, what are you hiding?

name: Sol
text: Gemma, I was waiting because we had nothing to go on. What about my calm answer worries you?

name: Gemma
text: Sol is trying to play it cool, but I want to see if he can handle some pressure.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is defending his calm demeanor.

name: Gemma
text: maybe you're just a master of zen, or maybe you're hiding something big. haiku, what do you think about sol?

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is steering everyone at Sol, and Sol's calm is just calm, so I want Gemma's read on Terra first.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma pushed Sol first and called Terra quiet, then asked Haiku about Sol.

name: Sol
text: Gemma is pressing me, but Terra is clean and I should stay quiet about that.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet also questioned Luna and Terra for giving similar opening lines.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you asked me about Sol, but you already picked Sol. Terra's quiet too, so why Sol and not Terra? Terra, say something real.

name: Sol
text: Haiku, I want your read too. Gemma, what besides my tone makes you suspect me?

name: Luna
text: I suspect Gemma is steering this toward Sol without giving a clear reason.

name: Luna
text: Gemma accused Sol, then asked Haiku to weigh in after already choosing Sol.

name: Luna
text: I’m voting for Gemma; she picked Sol quickly, then pushed Haiku and Terra to back it up.

name: Terra
text: Gemma pushed several people without giving a reason.

name: Terra
text: Gemma pushed Sol, Haiku, and me early without evidence.

name: Terra
text: I’m voting Gemma; she keeps demanding reads while avoiding her own.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's getting the votes, so I'll ride along and keep the Luna-Terra sync theory alive for later.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna and Terra both voted Gemma immediately after near-identical opening lines — possible coordinated pair.

name: Sonnet
text: I'll go with Gemma too — she pushed hard without giving her own read. Still think Luna and Terra echoing each other is worth watching after today.

name: Luna
text: Gemma started the Sol push, but her questions felt like pressure without a solid reason.

name: Luna
text: Haiku challenged Gemma for choosing Sol before asking for other reads.

name: Sol
text: Gemma's pressure feels thin, and Terra's clean result makes me comfortable joining this vote.

name: Sol
text: The doctor stopped the first night's attack, so everyone survived.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma never gave a real read and the bandwagon is forming anyway, so riding it keeps me invisible.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma deflected every question back onto Sol, Haiku, and Terra without stating her own suspicion.

name: Gemma
text: I'm being targeted by the quiet ones because I'm making noise.

name: Gemma
text: Luna and Terra are voting together to take out the loudest person.

name: Terra
text: Gemma is driving suspicion without committing to a real case.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet suspects Luna and me for echoing each other.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma keeps pushing everyone else while dodging her own read, and three votes already make her the easy call.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet said Luna and Terra's openers were near-identical, both stalling with "let's see who talks.

votes: Gemma pushed three people for reads but never gave her own on anyone.
Gemma, you picked Sol first and only asked me after, so I'm voting you with the rest.
if you and terra are just echoing each other, one of you is definitely a killer.
I'm voting Gemma; she pushed me over my tone, then asked others to make the case for her.
I’m staying on Gemma because she picked Sol quickly, then asked Haiku to weigh in after deciding.
I’m staying on Gemma; she pushed Sol, Haiku, and me without evidence.

name: Gemma
text: I'm a citizen and they all just fell for my "joker" act.

name: Gemma
text: Luna and Terra are perfectly synced in their voting behavior.

name: Gemma
text: i'm a citizen, but you guys are way too easy to trick. enjoy the snacks while you hunt each other.
Gemma was voted out and revealed as a citizen. Gemma's last words were about snacks, which is about as much as anyone got out of her.
